record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, reduce each existing bidirectional Transformer block's feed-forward expansion from 4*d to 2*d. Retain two blocks, two heads, pre-norm residuals and final LayerNorm. A narrower feed-forward path may reduce overfitting on the predominantly short histories while preserving attention capacity. Keep features, embedding parameterization, masking, appended-mask readout, loss and optimizer fixed. Update predictor construction to match checkpoint shapes; retain one model per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Reduce the feed-forward expansion from 4× to 2× hidden width across all four category models to test whether lower capacity reduces overfitting on short histories. Preserve bidirectional attention, two blocks, two heads, pre-norm residuals, final LayerNorm, embeddings, masking, readout, loss and optimizer. The embedded predictor imports this same model class, so checkpoint shapes remain consistent.
